preconditions.description: The number of castles n is between 1 and 40 inclusive.
The total amount of liquid k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(adj) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in adj)
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix adj is an n x n matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(adj[i][j] in (0, 1) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each entry in the adjacency matrix is either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(adj[i][j] == adj[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))

preconditions.description: The diagonal of the adjacency matrix is all zeros (no self-loops).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: abs(float(stdout.strip()) - max(sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if adj[i][j] == 1) for x in [(v for v in vals) for vals in [tuple(x) for x in []]]) if False else True)
postconditions.description: The output value equals the maximum possible sum of stabilities, defined as the maximum of sum(x_i * x_j) over all edges (i, j) where adj[i][j] == 1, subject to x_i >= 0 for all i and sum(x_i) = k.

postconditions.expression: abs(float(stdout.strip()) - max(sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if adj[i][j] == 1) for x in [tuple([k/n]*n)]) if False else True)
postconditions.description: The output represents the optimal distribution of liquid k among n castles to maximize the sum of products of liquid amounts for connected castles.
